title: Time And Costs Overruns Of Infrastructure Projects
definition: Time overrun refers to the delay in completing an infrastructure project beyond its scheduled completion date, while cost overrun represents the excess expenditure incurred over the originally approved estimated budget.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Infrastructure: Energy, Ports, Roads, Airports, Railways; Investment Models like PPP) and Prelims (economic indicators, MoSPI reports, and governance mechanisms).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Time And Costs Overruns Of Infrastructure Projects.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Human and Economic Geography
Basics of Indian Infrastructure sectors and financing models
